note: mapping_basis=data_labels: item codes are the .sav column names ips04a-ips04d (the .do does rename *, lower and uses the column name as item; core model s3 pattern 1). Each column carries an SPSS variable label with the sub-question wording and value labels 1 Aumentó / 2 Se mantiene igual / 3 Disminuyó / 99 Ns/Nc; 4/4 variable labels equal the shipped item_text exactly and equal the documentation (IPS04a-IPS04d) exactly. RESP: the .do (Bookmark 3: trend, lines 160-207) sets 99 Ns/Nc to missing (lines 175-178) and reverses with resp = 4 - x (lines 182-185; header comment lines 163-166: reversed from 1 Aumento 3 Disminuyo so higher means crime increased), so live resp 3 = Aumentó, 2 = Se mantiene igual, 1 = Disminuyó. Value labels and raw counts show only codes 1/2/3/99 (no 98, no system-missing), so the .do's 99-only missing rule is complete and no out-of-range value reaches the table. Route 9: raw .sav counts reversed per the .do equal live item x resp counts in 12/12 cells (resp3/resp2/resp1: ips04a 12903/13563/1874; b 21154/6444/589; c 23500/3608/284; d 25560/2559/217); the unreversed reading matches only the 4 middle-category cells. Per-item n (28340/28187/27392/28336) equals irw_table_sets() server-side per-item n; 112255 rows, 29195 of 29303 records appear. Ns/Nc (99) is absent from the table (a 963, b 1116, c 1911, d 967). TEXT (text_source=study_materials): instructions = the question 4 stem verbatim (¿Usted diría que la delincuencia en las siguientes zonas aumentó, se mantiene igual o disminuyó respecto a hace un año atrás?, line wrap joined), identical in the documentation under IPS04. item_text = the .sav variable labels, identical to the documentation and to the questionnaire rows 4a, 4b, 4d (line wraps joined). Deviation: the questionnaire prints 4c as 'En esta provincia (esta opción no se aplica en la CABA)'; the parenthetical is an applicability note naming CABA in the third person (not respondent-facing wording), is absent from the .sav label and the documentation, and is not shipped; item_text for ips04c is 'En esta provincia'. The parenthetical is not honoured in the data: of 1457 CABA records (cod_provincia 2), 977 give a substantive ips04c answer (743 Aumentó / 209 Se mantiene igual / 25 Disminuyó) and 480 Ns/Nc -- a response-data property, not an itemtext defect. option_text = value labels as printed (Aumentó / Se mantiene igual / Disminuyó), matching the questionnaire response grid, attached in the live (reversed) direction. Not shipped: the interviewer bracket [Leer opciones en cada subpregunta] (bracketed text is not read aloud, per the questionnaire's format conventions; it confirms the options were read for each sub-question), the chapter legend *Ahora me gustaría hacerle algunas preguntas acerca de sus opiniones sobre seguridad.*, which introduces PS question 1 rather than question 4, and the 99 Ns/Nc option, which is not in the live data. Single section_id, no section_prompt. language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation: INDEC publishes the ENV 2017 in Spanish only; English in the _translated columns produced by IRW (respecto a hace un año atrás rendered compared with a year ago; Se mantiene igual rendered Stayed the same). Issues-page entry owed once live. STEP 3b: dictionary Description (Perceived change in crime at four geographic levels) and the .do comment match IPS04a-d; 4 live items = 4 sub-questions, 3-level resp matches the Aumentó/Se mantiene igual/Disminuyó grid.
